title: chore(deps)(deps-dev): Bump the development-dependencies group with 2 updates
body:
Bumps the development-dependencies group with 2 updates: [svelte](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/tree/HEAD/packages/svelte) and [postcss](https://github.com/postcss/postcss). Updates `svelte` from 5.57.1 to 5.57.3
Release notes

Sourced from svelte's releases.

svelte@5.57.3

Patch Changes

  • fix: use the first valid fallback role in role for a11y checks (#19045)

  • chore: remove obsolete code (#19051)

  • fix: keep creating state sources for property checks during component init (#18949)

  • fix: skip redundant attribute writes during hydration (#18869)

  • fix: track missing state property checks in unowned deriveds (#18944)

  • fix: devalue link in hydratable_serialization_failed error (#18999)

svelte@5.57.2

Patch Changes

  • fix: don't create async deriveds for a component destroyed while waiting for its top-level await (#18931)

  • fix: prevent untracked derived reads from retaining disconnected dependencies (#18829)

  • fix: error if {:else} is followed by another {:else} or {:else if ...} (#18900)

  • fix: avoid tracking SvelteURLSearchParams during URL updates (#18791)

  • fix: restore hydration state when custom element attribute updates throw (#18467)

  • fix: attach event handlers that are assigned after a top-level await in production (#18933)

  • fix: flush anything pending before invoking flushSync callback function (#18878)

  • fix: preserve location information for await wrappers (#18859)

  • fix: keep a reactive assignment with no dependencies when migrate cannot turn it into a declaration (#18817)

  • fix: don't hang migrate on a declaration that shares a line with its script tag (#18816)

  • fix: prevent duplicate subscriptions when reconnecting deriveds (#18899)

  • fix: recover when an unexpected node replaces a nested boundary comment during hydration (#18925)

  • fix: print {#await} blocks that only have a pending branch (#18908)

  • fix: don't warn about a redundant link role on <area> elements without an href (#18872)

  • fix: don't throw state_unsafe_mutation when the focused element is removed while bind:activeElement is used (#18921)

  • fix: don't overwrite an unchanged spread value, preserving incomplete number input (#18864)

... (truncated)
